title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary
subtitle_source: subs_resolved/0989.txt (372 dialogue lines, full transcript read)
notes: Detective-cast (Conan/Edogawa Conan, Ayumi Yoshida, Genta Kojima, Mitsuhiko Tsuburaya, Ai Haibara, Detective Takagi) omitted by convention, as with other cases in this dataset. Not a murder: case_type is attempted_burglary/jewel theft -- Fujioka is caught mid-escape, so the watch is never actually gotten away with. Correction vs. the old `cases/` file: it spelled the cafe manager's given name 'Sadaharu Nishimura'; the transcript's on-screen name caption at 0:04:20 reads 'Nishimura Kidaharu (65) Cafe Manager', corrected here to 'Kidaharu Nishimura'. Otherwise the old file's stated culprit (Yuji Fujioka) and core mechanism (a tunnel dug from the neighboring produce store into the jewelry store, timed to overlap with unrelated cafe renovation noise) held up against the full transcript -- no culprit reversal or backwards clue found for this episode. Added detail not present in the old file: the fake Hawaii-prize-win phone deception Fujioka used to clear the Ogino family out of the produce store for 5 days; the diary-illustration clue (Michiyo Ogino drawn together with the three adjoining shops) that is the actual episode hook and title reference; Fujioka's unprompted, oddly precise knowledge of the watch's black-market resale price; and the courier company's confirmation that Fujioka missed exactly 5 days of work, matching both the tunnel-digging time and the Ogino family's trip window.
